pieces.file: Simondon — rich — a bag of parts, or one part doing several jobs.svg
pieces.title: One to move and one to read, or one that does both
pieces.caption: A knob with a light beside it: one part to move and one to read. Against it, one motor that both senses and pushes, so the state comes back through the hand already on it. Fewer parts doing more is what Simondon calls a better-made object. *What is real and what is a choice:* The before and after are the palace's own, from Palace Philosophies and the Haptic Handwheel page; Simondon's page does not mention the handwheel. Nothing is built yet. *Leaking in:* Haptic Handwheel.

verdicts.file: Simondon — rich — a bag of parts, or one part doing several jobs.svg
verdicts.why: The left side invents a machine neither page describes. The palace's case is two parts ("a knob with a light beside it ... one to move and one to read") against a motor that "both senses and pushes"; the figure draws four parts, adds a "buzzer to push back" (a buzzer does not push), and prints "three joints to fail" and "four jobs", none of which is on Simondon, Haptic Handwheel or Palace Philosophies.
